instruction: The left sidebar showing all slides is hidden. Can you display it again?

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(5); pyautogui.press('esc'); time.sleep(0.3); pyautogui.press('f10'); time.sleep(0.3); pyautogui.press('right', presses=2, interval=0.1); time.sleep(0.3); pyautogui.press('down', presses=11, interval=0.1); pyautogui.press('enter')

metadata.explanation: Task requires displaying the left sidebar showing all slides. The evaluator verifies 'Slides View' is present in the accessibility tree.

llm_judge_reasons: Semantic verification is correct: getter extracts accessibility tree which contains UI element state

Logical correctness: metric correctly parses XML and searches for document-frame elements with name='Slides View'
Expected value is semantically correct: 'Slides View' is the actual name of the slides sidebar in LibreOffice Impress
Data flow is sound: accessibility_tree (XML) -> parse XML -> search for element -> return presence score
Metric correctly handles expected parameter (accesses 'sidebar_element' directly from expected dict)
